game.name: Dance Central 3 (World)(En,Zh)
game.desc: Travel through time to learn the best dance crazes from across the ages, including disco moves of the 70s, hip-hop moves from the 80s, and the hottest moves on the dance floor today, all set to songs from artists like Usher, Gloria Gaynor, 50 Cent, TLC, and more. Familiar Dance Central crews and characters return with fresh new looks, and new faces join the dance party to keep the beats rocking with an innovative new party mode for up to eight players.
